verse.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

lines: Theophilus Sunday and 1Spirit lead worshippers through day two of Tarry Abuja, focusing on spiritual growth and evangelism.
Ohemaa Mercy Ministries hosts Tehillah 2025, bringing the Christian community together for a powerful revival worship experience.
The Ghana Revenue Authority clarifies that its new digital VAT system will not increase prices for existing compliant platforms.
A fire at the Mallam GRIDCo substation caused temporary power disruptions across Lapaz, Awoshie, Anyaa, and surrounding areas.
Veteran sports administrator Nana Fitz urges officials to take time in selecting the next Black Stars head coach.
prayers: Lord, grant swift restoration and safety to homes and businesses impacted by power disruptions in Accra.
We pray for wisdom and direction for our national leaders as they make crucial decisions affecting the public.
May God grant peace, financial comfort, and spiritual renewal to every family listening across our nation tonight.
